title: Fix breeze ignoring --providers-constraints-mode
body:
Breeze passes the providers constraints mode to the container as `PROVIDERS_CONSTRAINTS_MODE`, but the install script has read that option from `AIRFLOW_CONSTRAINTS_MODE`. The option is silently ignored, and providers always use the Airflow constraints mode.

Ran `breeze release-management install-provider-distributions --python 3.10 --mount-sources remove --use-airflow-version 3.1.6 --providers-constraints-mode constraints-no-providers`:
  - `main` branch shows `Determined providers constraints as: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/airflow/constraints-main/constraints-source-providers-3.10.txt`
  - This branch shows `Determined providers constraints as: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/airflow/constraints-main/constraints-no-providers-3.10.txt`

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import install_airflow_and_providers as m
+
+
+def test_providers_constraints_mode_is_read_from_providers_env_var(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("DEFAULT_CONSTRAINTS_BRANCH", "constraints-main")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MOUNT_SOURCES", "selected")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("AIRFLOW_CONSTRAINTS_MODE", "constraints")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("PROVIDERS_CONSTRAINTS_MODE", "constraints-no-providers")
+
+    ctx = m.install_airflow_and_providers.make_context("install_airflow_and_providers", [])
+
+    assert ctx.params["airflow_constraints_mode"] == "constraints"
+    assert ctx.params["providers_constraints_mode"] == "constraints-no-providers"
